question: In a certain code language, 'TIME' is coded as 61 and 'POND' is coded as 59. How will 'BLUE' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aefcd090e4721ab168474cd72dc7f0a88835716ce3c569f68482016e79ea81ae.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 'TIME' is coded as 61

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cecfbecc8cd1773b340706478f8d84d970ab79c49ecbd2f26ff9b4d7fd4391f1.png] 

And

'POND' is coded as 59

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05b6eb7aac56499d9a781db1caecfcac5f1925572ccaec0d3db4c4e65f0bdeba.png] 

Similarly,

'BLUE' be coded

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb7f92abf1b33e8ce3b661b170fcc73c022f57f1bf60f09b7a81817a2c8afb11.png] 

Thus, the correct answer is **'68'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
